newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK BANKS SELL 400MLN ECUS, 150-250MARKS AT FIX.
newsitem.headline: GREEK BANKS SELL 400MLN ECUS, 150-250MARKS AT FIX.

text.p: Greek and foreign banks sold more than 400 million ecus and 150-250 million marks for drachmas, bank dealers said.
"Banks sold ecus and marks for a Swiss customer who closed out his position," said a dealer."He had opened a position a few days ago."
Ecu/drachma eased to the 302.60 level from 302.690 on Tuesday, dealers said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
